understood.definition: Form of understand (participle past): To know the meaning of; to parse or have parsed correctly; to comprehend.

unflinching.definition: Without flinching; staying committed despite any difficulty; steadfast.

unfolding.definition: Form of unfold (gerund participle present): To undo a folding.

uniforms.definition: Form of uniform (plural): A distinctive outfit that serves to identify members of a group, company, prison inmates, etc.

universal.definition: A characteristic or property that particular things have in common.

unlikely.definition: Not likely; improbable; not to be reasonably expected.

unties.definition: Form of untie (indicative present singular third-person): To loosen, as something interlaced or knotted; to disengage the parts of.

upstairs.definition: Up the stairs; on or to a higher floor or level.

upstart.definition: One who has suddenly gained wealth, power, or other prominence, but either has not received social acceptance or has become arrogant or presumptuous.

useful.definition: Having a practical or beneficial use.

uses.definition: Form of use (plural): The act of using.

using.definition: Form of use (gerund participle present): To utilize or employ.

valleys.definition: Form of valley (plural): An elongated depression cast between hills or mountains, often with a river flowing through it.

value.definition: The quality that renders something desirable or valuable; worth.

ventures.definition: Form of venture (plural): A risky or daring undertaking or journey.

veranda.definition: A gallery, platform, or balcony, usually roofed and often partly enclosed, extending along the outside of a building.

versed.definition: Form of verse (past): To compose verses.

very.definition: To a great extent or degree.

victim.definition: One that is harmed—killed, injured, subjected to oppression, deceit, or otherwise adversely affected—by someone or something, especially another person or event, force, or condition; in particular.

victory.definition: The condition or state of having won a battle or competition, or having succeeded in an effort; (countable) an instance of this.

viennese.definition: Of or relating to Vienna (the capital of Austria).

vigorously.definition: With intense energy, force or vigor.

villages.definition: Form of village (plural): A rural habitation of size between a hamlet and a town.

vines.definition: Form of vine (plural): Any plant whose stem requires support and which climbs by tendrils or twining.

vineyard.definition: A grape plantation, especially one used in the production of wine.

vivacious.definition: Lively and animated; full of life and energy.

voice.definition: Sound uttered by the mouth, especially by human beings in speech or song; sound thus uttered considered as possessing some special quality or character.

wait.definition: To delay movement or action until some event or time; to remain neglected or in readiness.

waiting.definition: Form of wait (gerund participle present): To delay movement or action until some event or time; to remain neglected or in readiness.

waits.definition: Form of wait (indicative present singular third-person): To delay movement or action until some event or time; to remain neglected or in readiness.

walk.definition: To move on the feet by alternately setting each foot (or pair or group of feet, in the case of animals with four or more feet) forward, with at least one foot on the ground at all times. Compare run.

walking.definition: Form of walk (gerund participle present): To move on the feet by alternately setting each foot (or pair or group of feet, in the case of animals with four or more feet) forward, with at least one foot on the ground at al.

walks.definition: Form of walk (indicative present singular third-person): To move on the feet by alternately setting each foot (or pair or group of feet, in the case of animals with four or more feet) forward, with at least one foot on t.

want.definition: To wish for or desire (something); to feel a need or desire for; to crave, hanker, or demand.

wanted.definition: Form of want (participle past): To wish for or desire (something); to feel a need or desire for; to crave, hanker, or demand.

wants.definition: Form of want (indicative present singular third-person): To wish for or desire (something); to feel a need or desire for; to crave, hanker, or demand.

war.definition: Organized, large-scale, armed conflict between countries or between national, ethnic, or other sizeable groups, usually but not always involving active engagement of military forces.

was.definition: Form of be (first-person indicative past singular): As an auxiliary verb.

watch.definition: To look at, see, or view for a period of time.

watchword.definition: A word used as a motto, as expressive of a principle, belief, or rule of action; a rallying cry.

way.definition: To do with a place or places.

weak.definition: Lacking in force (usually strength) or ability.

weeks.definition: Form of week (plural): Any period of seven consecutive days.

went.definition: Form of go (past): To move, either physically or in an abstract sense.

were.definition: Form of be (indicative past second-person singular): As an auxiliary verb.

weren’t.definition: Form of were (abbreviation contraction): Form of be (indicative past second-person singular): As an auxiliary verb.

what.definition: In what way; to what extent.

what’s.definition: In what way; to what extent.

when.definition: At what time? At which time? Upon which occasion or circumstance? Used to introduce direct or indirect questions about time.

where.definition: In, at or to what place.

whew.definition: To whistle with a shrill pipe, like a plover.

whilst.definition: Often preceded by the: During the time; meanwhile.

whisper.definition: The act of speaking in a quiet voice, especially without vibration of the vocal cords; the sound thus produced.

who.definition: A person under discussion; a question of which person.

why.definition: Form of wye (alternative): The name of the Latin script letter Y/y.

wicked.definition: Evil or mischievous by nature; morally reprehensible.

wickered.definition: Composed of or covered by wickerwork or wickers.

wide.definition: Having a large physical extent from side to side.

widely.definition: In a wide manner; across a wide area.

wife.definition: A married woman, especially in relation to her spouse.

will.definition: Used to express the future tense, sometimes with an implication of volition or determination when used in the first person. Compare shall.

willingly.definition: Of one’s own free will; freely and spontaneously.

window.definition: An opening, usually covered by one or more panes of clear glass, to allow light and air from outside to enter a building or vehicle.

windows.definition: Form of window (plural): An opening, usually covered by one or more panes of clear glass, to allow light and air from outside to enter a building or vehicle.

wine.definition: An alcoholic beverage made by fermenting grape juice, with an ABV ranging from 5.5–16%.

winepress.definition: A press used to extract juice from grapes as the first step of winemaking.

wipe.definition: To move an object over, maintaining contact, with the intention of removing some substance from the surface. (Compare rub.)

wipes.definition: Form of wipe (plural): The act of wiping something.

witch.definition: A person (now usually particularly a woman) who uses magical or similar supernatural powers to influence or predict events, particularly one with malicious motives.

with.definition: Form of withe (alternative): A flexible, slender shoot or twig, especially when used as a band or for binding; a withy.

withal.definition: Together with the rest; besides; in addition.

withdraw.definition: To draw or pull (something) away or back from its original position or situation.

withdrawing.definition: Form of withdraw (gerund participle present): To draw or pull (something) away or back from its original position or situation.

withdraws.definition: Form of withdraw (indicative present singular third-person): To draw or pull (something) away or back from its original position or situation.

within.definition: In or into the interior; inside.

women.definition: Form of woman (plural): An adult female human.

won’t.definition: Will not (negative auxiliary); used to indicate a future non-occurring action.

words.definition: Form of word (plural): The smallest unit of language that has a particular meaning and can be expressed by itself; the smallest discrete, meaningful unit of language. (contrast morpheme.)

work.definition: To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

working.definition: Form of work (gerund participle present): To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

world.definition: The subjective human experience, regarded collectively; human collective existence; existence in general; the reality we live in.

worse.definition: Form of bad (comparative): Of low quality.

worships.definition: Form of worship (indicative present singular third-person): To reverence (a deity, etc.) with supreme respect and veneration; to perform religious exercises in honour of.

would.definition: Past tense of will; usually followed by a bare infinitive.

wringing.definition: Form of wring (gerund participle present): Often followed by out: to squeeze or twist (something moist) tightly so that liquid is forced out.

wrist.definition: The complex joint between forearm bones, carpus, and metacarpals where the hand is attached to the arm; the carpus in a narrow sense.

writers.definition: Form of writer (plural): A person who writes, or produces literary work; an author can refer to themselves as "the writer".

writing.definition: Form of write (gerund participle present): To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

written.definition: Form of write (participle past): To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

wrote.definition: Form of write (past): To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

years.definition: Form of year (plural): A period of time akin to the time taken for the Earth to undergo a full cycle of seasons.

yell.definition: To shout; holler; make a loud sound with the voice, especially to express intense emotions such as anger or excitement.

yes.definition: An affirmative expression; an answer that shows agreement or acceptance.

yet.definition: Thus far; up to the present; up to some unspecified time.

you.definition: To address (a person) using the pronoun you (in the past, especially to use you rather than thou, when you was considered more formal).

young.definition: Offspring, especially the immature offspring of animals.

youngest.definition: Form of young (superlative): In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.
